args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel documents (flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank
- Travel insurance information

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Water shoes (for snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Hat with wide brim
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkel gear (optional, can rent at Hanauma Bay)
- Beach bag
- Reusable water bottle

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes (for Diamond Head)
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Quick-dry t-shirts
- Rain jacket (weather can change quickly)

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- Pearl Harbor: Respectful attire (covered shoulders, no shorts for some areas)
- Luau at Polynesian Cultural Center: Hawaiian shirt or dress (optional but fun)
- Spa day: Nothing needed (provided by spa)
- Kayaking at Kailua Beach: Quick-dry clothing

TOILETRIES:
- Personal medications
- Prescription glasses/contacts
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Makeup (if desired)

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books or e-reader
- Travel pillow
- Earplugs
- Small backpack for day trips
- Plastic bags for wet items
- Snacks for day trips
- Travel laundry detergent (for longer stays)

REMEMBER:
- Check weather forecast before finalizing packing
- Leave room in luggage for souvenirs
- Consider laundry options at accommodation
